<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most plausible molecular formula for the neutral compound is C₁₂H₆O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 182.0368 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ ion at 183.044 Da, matching the observed base peak). A known structure with this formula is acenaphthylene‑1,2‑dione. Its SMILES representation is “O=C1c2ccc3c(c2)C(=O)C1=3”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the deduced formula.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1c2ccc3c(c2)C(=O)C1=3</final_answer>
